caustic.name: Caustic
caustic.description: Salt eats at armour and skin. -1 defense.

crushed.name: Crushed
crushed.description: Pressed down by abyssal weight. -1 AP.

burning.name: Burning
burning.description: Takes 2 fire damage at the start of its turn.

regen.name: Mending
regen.description: Heals 2 at the start of its turn.

stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.description: Cannot move or act this turn.

bleeding.name: Bleeding
bleeding.description: Takes 2 physical damage at the start of its turn.

sc_parched.name: Parched
sc_parched.description: Salt dries the body and the nerve. -1 AP, -1 attack.

hc_darkened.name: Darkened
hc_darkened.description: Blind in the lightless deep. -1 attack, -1 defense.

hc_lured.name: Lured
hc_lured.description: Dazzled by a bioluminescent lure. -1 defense and -1 AP.

hc_hushed.name: Hushed
hc_hushed.description: The bell has rung over them. -2 attack and -1 AP.

rt_hymned.name: Hymned
rt_hymned.description: Carried by the choir. +1 attack, +1 defense.

rt_drowning.name: Drowning
rt_drowning.description: Takes 2 brine damage at the start of its turn.

rt_wrung.name: Wrung
rt_wrung.description: Drained of water and will. -1 attack, -1 AP.

sv_sooted.name: Sooted
sv_sooted.description: Powder soot clogs the eyes. -1 defense and takes 1 fire damage at the start of its turn.

sv_harpooned.name: Harpooned
sv_harpooned.description: Hooked on a line. Cannot move and -1 defense.

sv_indebted.name: In Debt
sv_indebted.description: Owes the Compact and moves like it. -1 attack and -1 AP.

ra_bloom.name: Bloom
ra_bloom.description: Calcite growth surges through the body. +1 attack. Applying Bloom again adds another stack (+1 attack each).

ra_dazed.name: Dazed
ra_dazed.description: Cut off from the synapse. -2 AP.

ra_entangled.name: Entangled
ra_entangled.description: Creeping calcite tendrils drag at the legs. -1 AP.

lk_vigil.name: Vigil
lk_vigil.description: Kept awake by the lamp. +1 defense, +1 attack.

oc_wet.name: Wet
oc_wet.description: Slick with the old sea. The unit does not dry out.

oc_dread.name: Dread
oc_dread.description: Something is looking up at it. -1 attack, -1 AP.

oc_latched.name: Latched
oc_latched.description: A parasite is feeding. Lose 2 HP at the start of each turn per stack; stacks to 3.

oc_inked.name: Inked
oc_inked.description: Blinded in a cloud of black. -2 attack, -1 defense.

gy_pinned.name: Pinned
gy_pinned.description: Skewered to the ground by a shrike-spike or nest-hook. Cannot move.

gy_harried.name: Harried
gy_harried.description: Circled and pecked at. -1 defense per stack (stacks to 2).

tangled.name: Tangled
tangled.description: Weed wrapped round the legs: -1 AP.
